remarks: Welcome to your dream oasis in North Stamford! This stunning lakefront property offers a perfect blend of luxury and tranquility, nestled in a serene neighborhood where privacy reigns supreme. As you approach this modern split-level home, the charm of its inviting lane and lush surroundings will captivate you. Step inside to discover a gourmet kitchen that's a culinary enthusiast's paradise, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and heated flooring for added comfort. The spacious living and dining areas flow seamlessly, accentuated by vaulted ceilings and a cozy fireplace-ideal for entertaining or quiet evenings. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with a standing jacuzzi, promising restful nights and rejuvenating mornings. This home also boasts three additional bedrooms, ensuring ample space for family and guests. Both the primary bedroom and family room offer picturesque views of the lake, making outdoor gatherings a breeze. Venture to the amazing lower level designed for entertainment, perfect for movie nights or game days. The extraordinary laundry room, equipped with a whirlpool sink, adds convenience to your daily routine. Enjoy exclusive access to a private beach and dock on the lake, where you can bask in the sun or take a leisurely swim. With natural gas heating, a generator, and Tesla solar panels, this home is efficient and reliable. Don't miss this rare opportunity-where luxury meets nature. Live the lifestyle you've always dreamed of!
